scope: Repeat the preregistered A and B arms across the full beta-ready sample. Change only the drawdown-stop threshold. Do not use this sensitivity to approve or select a live strategy.

runtime_override.meaning: Effectively disables the drawdown stop for this finite historical sample.

decision_rule: Report total turnover and risk outcomes for both arms. Do not select the higher-volume arm. Report any gross-cap stop separately.

methodology_skills.name: ml4t-run-backtest
methodology_skills.reason: Run the frozen A/B comparison through the installed event-driven engine.
invariants: Use Engine with native resting limit orders.
Preserve next-bar price-touch fill semantics and the positive-volume gate.
Keep every frozen execution assumption unchanged except the drawdown stop.
methodology_skills.verification: Focused synthetic execution checks and full-sample Engine run.

methodology_skills.name: ml4t-risk-metrics
methodology_skills.reason: Interpret account-level drawdown and ending inventory risk.
invariants: Report drawdown and inventory alongside gross completed volume.
Do not equate a long/short pair with a dollar-neutral hedge.
Keep marked ending inventory distinct from realized liquidation P&L.
methodology_skills.verification: Report account equity drawdown, per-leg marked inventory, and emergency exits.

methodology_skills.name: ml4t-cost-model
methodology_skills.reason: Audit whether execution-cost assumptions constrain the interpretation.
invariants: Do not change frozen maker-fee or emergency-exit cost assumptions in this sensitivity.
Disclose that OHLCV touch fills do not model queue position, actual passive fills, or market impact.
methodology_skills.verification: Retain the pre-frozen execution config and report the fill-model limitation.

methodology_skills.name: ml4t-transaction-costs
methodology_skills.reason: Separate the turnover sensitivity from evidence of real executable capacity.
invariants: Do not treat simulated maker turnover as verified venue volume.
Do not promote either exploratory arm based on this comparison.
methodology_skills.verification: Compare only the two pre-registered arms and preserve the production-readiness caveat.
